title: Surreal Cracked Earth Globe
description: A large cracked green sphere resembling Earth dominates the scene, revealing a glowing red and blue portal with floating castle ruins inside. A turtle crawls across the top while a test tube pours white paw prints from above and a waterfall of paw prints cascades from a crack into a park bench below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a large cracked green sphere like Earth with multiple blue eyes growing on its surface and glowing orange roots at its base. A red and blue swirling portal inside reveals floating castle ruins. A realistic turtle crawls on the top right. From the top left a glass test tube pours white animal paw prints. A waterfall of white paw prints flows from a lower crack onto a wooden park bench. Dark cloudy sky transitions to blue with bubbles, surrounded by lush green plants and a tall pine tree in the background.
